description: bookA and bookB run sequentially (bookA -> bookB), each registering a compensation subscription on the SAME `cancel` handler element. The compensation throw then activates one handler instance per completed activity — two `cancel` instances bound to the same element id in one scope. Completing the two handler jobs must retire each pending handler by its element-INSTANCE key (#897), never misattribute a completion via element-id matching, and only route the throw onward once BOTH handlers are done.
